cases.name: shift_forward_cascade
cases.description: Day shift: A100 +1 day pushes B200 +1 (FS) and C300 +1 (12 h slack rounded up to a whole civil day).

cases.name: shift_backward_blocked
cases.description: Pulling a successor earlier than its predecessor allows is rejected; an unlinked activity may move back.

cases.name: shift_roundtrip_no_changes
cases.description: +2 then -2 days returns to the native schedule: no apply package can be built.

cases.name: daily_tail_insert
cases.description: Moving the 2026-03-03 day of A100 to 2026-03-05 shifts that day and the rest of the tail by +2 and cascades B200/C300.

cases.name: defer_tail_next_period
cases.description: Defer the last day of C300 to the first day after the horizon.

cases.name: stagger_tail
cases.description: Split-and-stagger A100 after its first day: one division with a one-day gap; then a request for too many divisions.

cases.name: horizon_edit_and_containment
cases.description: A 7-day horizon blocks moving C300 past its end; the range is frozen once local moves exist; preference is persisted.

cases.name: horizon_preference_v2_migration
cases.description: A version-2 stored preference (duration only) migrates to version 3 with a derived start day.

cases.name: horizon_preference_v3
cases.description: A version-3 stored preference fixes the start day and duration.

cases.name: horizon_preference_invalid
cases.description: A corrupt stored preference falls back to 28 days with a warning.

cases.name: horizon_edit_start_finish_reset
cases.description: Port coverage: editStart/editFinish/editDuration rejections (range, no pending work, bad date, civil range), local-changes freeze, and reset reloading the saved v3 preference.

cases.name: tail_then_whole_moves
cases.description: Port coverage: whole-activity moves after a daily-tail move take the non-uniform direct branch of moveActivity.

cases.name: retail_cascaded_successor
cases.description: Port coverage: a daily-tail move on a cascaded successor rebuilds the direct preview and re-cascades it.

cases.name: direct_cascade_conflict
cases.description: Port coverage: a whole move into a directly moved successor fails incomingSafe; a tail move fails in the re-cascade (conflicto entre movimiento directo y cascada).

cases.name: out_of_range_controls
cases.description: Port coverage: with a 3-day horizon, eligibility/state of out-of-range work, a tail target outside the horizon and a horizon-range move.

cases.name: stagger_horizon_range
cases.description: Port coverage: stagger targets beyond the horizon (horizon-range) and invalid stagger requests.

cases.name: invalid_requests
cases.description: Port coverage: unknown activity/fragment, zero move, foreign fragment, same-day target, malformed target date.

cases.name: scenario_and_fragment_move
cases.description: Port coverage: moveFragment (pure) and buildScenario before and after a move.

cases.name: preference_v3_start_outside
cases.description: Port coverage: a v3 preference whose start day has no pending work falls back to the derived start with the stored duration.

cases.name: preference_numeric_forms
cases.description: Port coverage: JSON numbers 2.0 and 1e1 are integers for JSON.parse.

cases.name: preference_duplicate_keys
cases.description: Port coverage: duplicate JSON keys, last one wins.

cases.name: preference_oversized_utf8
cases.description: Port coverage: the 1024-byte limit counts UTF-8 bytes, not characters.

cases.name: preference_bad_start_day
cases.description: Port coverage: an impossible start day invalidates the preference.

cases.name: preference_extra_key
cases.description: Port coverage: unknown keys invalidate the preference.

cases.name: tail_roundtrip
cases.description: A daily tail moved away and back (whole-second times): instants and text both return to the original.
